name: GPU.NET
rootCause: DefiLlama lists GPU.NET as an Ethereum incident on 2026-06-03 with about $10,600 lost. The accessible record identifies it as a Protocol Logic event, but does not reveal the specific logic flaw, attacker, or transaction path. Unknown from the available evidence. DefiLlama classifies GPU.NET as a Protocol Logic incident with technique Unknown, but the available public evidence does not identify the broken invariant, function, or transaction sequence that caused the loss.
